6afeb12a489c2c15bdef16e4 description: [PH] Long time no see, comrade. The Party remembers its friends. A small favor to begin: mark the power room in the D2 bunker on Reserve, remove three Raiders who are making the paperwork difficult, and leave through D2. Not all in one day, the Party is patient.
6afeb12a489c2c15bdef16e4 successMessageT: [PH] Excellent. Your file has been moved to the 'useful' drawer.
6afeb12b489c2c15bdef16e6: Mark the power room in the D2 bunker on Reserve
6afeb12b489c2c15bdef16eb: Extract from Reserve through the D2 exit
6afeb12d8a2bf95dc3c703aa description: [PH] Trade is the lifeblood of a harmonious society. We are opening a new route through Shoreline. Mark the main road by the gas station and the train cars by the railway bridge. The caravans will follow.
6afeb12d8a2bf95dc3c703aa successMessageT: [PH] The route is surveyed. Commerce will flow. Ten-thousand-year plan, step one.
6afeb12e8a2bf95dc3c703ac: Mark the main road by the gas station on Shoreline
6afeb12e8a2bf95dc3c703ad: Mark the train cars by the railway bridge on Shoreline
6afeb133df04bdf8630f0ccf description: [PH] The route is open, now we need goods on it. Medical goods. Leave a stimulant at five drop points on Shoreline: the south pier, the weather station, the village house, the gas station office and the bus station office. These are entirely legitimate pharmaceuticals.
6afeb133df04bdf8630f0ccf successMessageT: [PH] All five delivered. Our pharmaceutical exports have grown five hundred percent.

6afeb134f4a03ce7764de4bc description: [PH] Someone has been ambushing our caravans. They wear patches with cartoon girls on them and say 'hooah'. USEC. Ten of them, please. A reminder of who keeps the order.
6afeb134f4a03ce7764de4bc successMessageT: [PH] Ten. Interesting. Several were carrying business cards for a certain gun shop.
6afeb13573c586a224470329 description: [PH] The patches lead back to Lighthouse. The Rogues are former USEC, and someone is supplying them. Ten Rogues. The supplier will understand the message.
6afeb13573c586a224470329 successMessageT: [PH] Message delivered. I suspect a certain 'operator' is very upset right now.
6afeb137d0c21ba797f7842d description: [PH] Western pharmaceuticals are expensive and arrogant. Traditional medicine is efficient. Bring me three Golden Star balms and two packs of Analgin, found in raid. For the clinic.
6afeb137d0c21ba797f7842d successMessageT: [PH] The clinic thanks you. The Golden Star is especially good for bureaucratic headaches.
6afeb137d0c21ba797f7842f: Find Golden Star balm in raid
6afeb138974a4842a8a976d1 description: [PH] Cultural heritage must be preserved, especially when it is valuable. Three antique teapots, two antique vases, an Axel parrot and two Raven figurines, found in raid. For the museum.
6afeb138974a4842a8a976d1 successMessageT: [PH] The museum is very grateful. It is a very private museum.
6afeb138974a4842a8a976d7: Find Axel parrot figurine in raid
6afeb13982735cde65f1a9dc description: [PH] Our engineers have copied Killa's helmet. Before mass production, we need field data. Wear the original Maska and score five headshots, then survive. Results first, safety second.
6afeb13982735cde65f1a9dc successMessageT: [PH] Test passed. The copy will be... almost as good.
6afeb13982735cde65f1a9de: Eliminate any target with headshots while wearing Killa's Maska-1SCh helmet, and survive the raid
6afeb13a3774896637aeac6a description: [PH] You will be enrolled in an exchange program. Very prestigious. Reach Attention level five and Intellect level seven. There will be an exam. There is always an exam.
6afeb13a3774896637aeac6a successMessageT: [PH] Top marks. Your parents would be proud. I have informed them.
6afeb13a3774896637aeac6c: Reach level 5 of the Attention skill
6afeb13a3774896637aeac6d: Reach level 7 of the Intellect skill
6afeb13c3f6f4344292a740d description: [PH] A package of ours was seized and is sitting in the Reserve command bunker. The Raiders guarding it lack the correct forms. Remove four of them and bring me the package from the control room.
6afeb13c3f6f4344292a740d successMessageT: [PH] The chain of custody is restored. Nobody signed for it, which is how we like it.
6afeb13c3f6f4344292a740f: Eliminate Raiders in the command bunker on Reserve

6afeb13d0b3253232fabbc6b description: [PH] Inside the package was a map of the air defenses on Reserve. Mark all six anti-aircraft guns for our analysts. Then clear the Scavs who moved into the command bunker after you left.
6afeb13d0b3253232fabbc6b successMessageT: [PH] Six guns, catalogued. The bunker is ours again. Very efficient.
6afeb13d0b3253232fabbc7f: Eliminate Scavs in the command bunker
6afeb13eecfd8429da8bf49a description: [PH] The British gentleman at the petrol station. I want to understand him. Become his good friend, level three, and bring me fifteen hundred dollars. The dollars are unrelated. Probably.
6afeb13eecfd8429da8bf49a successMessageT: [PH] Thank you. The old empire and the new one, sharing tea.
6afeb13fc02ceecb190f670f description: [PH] The sun never sets on an empire, but it does set on Lighthouse. Three BEAR operatives meet there in the evening. Remove them between seven and midnight, and bring their dogtags. For filing.
6afeb13fc02ceecb190f670f successMessageT: [PH] Filed. The evening meetings have been canceled.
6afeb13fc02ceecb190f6711: Eliminate BEAR PMCs on Lighthouse between 19:00 and 24:00
